tokens.name: material
tokens.usage: Ground. The system material behind every window (Popover, Sidebar, Mica, Acrylic), as designs draw it over a desktop with blur 30 and saturate 180%. Code never draws it: the window is transparent and MyGo's Vibrancy shows the system's.

tokens.name: solid
tokens.usage: Ground. The window fill where no material shows (Linux, Windows 10, Reduce transparency). Every contrast in the audit is computed on it.

tokens.name: detail
tokens.usage: Region. The detail pane of the accounts window over the material.

tokens.name: solid-detail
tokens.usage: Region. The accounts detail pane on the solid ground.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Surface. Result cards, the identity list, settings groups, banners, the drop zone. No outline: a card-rim along its top edge.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Surface. Text inputs, with a line hairline; the clone helper's input.

tokens.name: menu
tokens.usage: Surface. How a system menu and a dialog window look in designs (blur 36, saturate 200%). Code uses the system's menus and the dialog window's own material.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Surface. The chosen segment of a segmented control, with shadow-raised.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Surface. Tooltips and toasts. Text on it is on-inverse.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: State. The resting ground of a control: buttons, the filter field, a segmented track. MyGo Surface.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: State. Under the pointer: a control, an icon button, a row. MyGo SurfaceHover.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: State. The chosen row of a list (accounts sidebar, bind list), the chosen settings tab. Neutral, never the accent: shape and the accent marker say which one.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: State. A pressed control; the row being confirmed in a result card. MyGo SurfacePressed.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Role. Commit mint, darkened to read as text: the one primary button, switches on, radios and checkboxes, text buttons and links, the winning identity's marker, the drop zone outline. MyGo Accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Role. A hovered primary button.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Role. A pressed primary button.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Role. Text and glyphs on the accent. Dark text in dark mode, as MyGo does for a light accent. MyGo AccentText.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Role. The mint as a tint: the drop zone while a folder is dragged over it, the empty state's key tile. Never under small text.

tokens.name: commit
tokens.usage: Role. Brand mint, the keyhole core of the product icon. Graphics only: the color mark's core, the cover, the countdown line at 45%. White on it is 2.5:1, so never a ground under text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Role. The keyboard focus ring, 3 outside the control's own shape; a focused input's outline turns accent. Opaque accent under Increase contrast.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Role. Selected text: the one place mint is a ground under text.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Text. Names, values, everything that must be read first. MyGo Text.

tokens.name: fg2
tokens.usage: Text. Second-strongest: values beside a muted label in a details grid, the body of a notice.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Text. Hints, emails, paths, group headings, status lines, the glyphs of the title row and footer. MyGo TextMuted.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Text. Disabled labels, placeholders and decoration; never text that must be read.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text. On inverse: tooltips and toasts. MyGo InverseText.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Meaning. A failed git, a read-only store, save and field errors, Delete, the error glyph of a finding, the inner outline of a card with an error. MyGo Danger.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Meaning. The ground of the read-only warning badge and of an error problem bar.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Meaning. Glyphs and outlines only, never text: a card without a match, a warning finding. MyGo Warning.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Meaning. The ground of a warning problem bar.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Meaning. A passing connectivity dot, the check mark of Configuration OK. Close to the accent in hue, so never the only cue: always beside its words or its identity. MyGo Success.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Line. Hairlines between rows and the outline of a text field; cards and bars have none. MyGo Border.

tokens.name: rim
tokens.usage: Line. A 0.5 light line along the top edge of a window or dialog, inside the system's outline.

tokens.name: card-rim
tokens.usage: Line. The same 0.5 line along the top edge of a card, so a card reads as a sheet of glass rather than a box. Idset's signature.

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Line. Scroll bar thumbs, 6 wide. MyGo Scrollbar.

tokens.name: id-blue
tokens.usage: Identity. A preset identity color. Data, not a theme role: initial badges and dots, always beside the identity's name; also what an invalid value shows as.

tokens.name: id-green
tokens.usage: Identity. A preset identity color.

tokens.name: id-orange
tokens.usage: Identity. A preset identity color.

tokens.name: id-red
tokens.usage: Identity. A preset identity color.

tokens.name: id-purple
tokens.usage: Identity. A preset identity color.

tokens.name: id-yellow
tokens.usage: Identity. A preset identity color; its badge letter is white, by the letter rule (160 is under 165).

tokens.name: id-ink-dark
tokens.usage: Identity. Badge letter on a light identity color (0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B > 165).

tokens.name: id-ink-light
tokens.usage: Identity. Badge letter on any other identity color.

tokens.name: logo-tile
tokens.usage: Logo. The graphite tile of the product icon (its gradient runs #5b6170 to #16181d).

tokens.name: logo-folder
tokens.usage: Logo. The ivory folder of the product icon (its face runs #f6f1e7 to #dcd3c3), with the keyhole cut through it.

tokens.name: logo-core
tokens.usage: Logo. The lit mint keyhole inside the cut (its gradient runs #7ff0c8 to #14b896, with a glow); commit mint lit up.

tokens.name: tray-ink
tokens.usage: Tray. The icon on Windows and Linux, visible on light and dark taskbars; macOS uses a template image the system tints.

tokens.name: tray-warning
tokens.usage: Tray. The warning badge triangle, white !.

tokens.name: tray-error
tokens.usage: Tray. The error badge circle, white !.

type.note: Sizes at the macOS font size 13; elsewhere the theme font size is 14 and every style scales with it (t.Rem). Chinese takes the same size and a 2 taller line, no tracking.

styles.name: display

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Window and pane titles (the panel's "Idset", a level 1 heading), the identity name in a result card and in the editor, empty and read-only titles. Code: t.Rem(1.15), 600.

styles.name: emphasis

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Everything else, and all widget text: buttons, fields, menus, rows. Code: theme FontSize.

styles.name: secondary
styles.usage: Hints, notes, emails, status lines, the drop zone line, a problem bar's explanation. Code: t.Rem(0.92).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Group headings ("Identities · 3"), detail labels, a settings tab's label. Code: t.Rem(0.85), 600.
styles.sample: Idset 让每个文件夹用对身份

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Folders in a list row, the read-only reason, "Copied", timestamps. Code: t.Rem(0.85).
styles.sample: Idset 让每个文件夹用对身份

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: The initial in a 32 result badge; a 28 list badge takes 13 / 600. Code: t.Rem(1.25), 600.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Paths, aliases, commands and key names next to secondary or body text. Code: t.Rem(0.88), monospace.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: The same next to small text: the clone helper's output, a finding's command. Code: t.Rem(0.85), monospace.

spacing.note: Multiples of Theme.Spacing (4 at default; 3 compact, 5 roomy), so density scales them. Values at default. Eight steps and nothing in between: 2 and 6 are the inline half steps, the rest multiples of 4. Code: t.Space(n).

tokens.name: space-0_5
tokens.usage: A name and its second line; the dots of a countdown; icon buttons side by side in a card.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon buttons in the footer; rows of a result card's details; under the title row; between a field and its output.

tokens.name: space-1_5
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a button or a line; filter chips; the lines of an empty state.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Related controls and button rows; a list row's vertical padding; badge to text; the footer's side insets.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding; the panel's content inset at the sides and below; between blocks of the panel; a list row's left inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The title row's left inset; settings pane top; between groups of a pane.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Around a dialog's content and the about window's; between the parts of an empty state; a settings pane and the account editor at the sides and below, and between their groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above and below an empty state in a settings pane.

radius.note: By role, not by size. A capsule or circle is half its height (radius-pill). Windows and dialogs: the system draws their corners.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small marks: key caps in a hint, the scroll thumb's ends, the countdown line.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Text inputs, a row's hover and selected fill, the 28 list badge, menu entries in designs. Code: theme.FieldRadius.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The 32 result badge and the accounts header badge.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the identity list, the drop zone, settings groups, banners, problem bars, the 44 warning badge. Code: theme.CardRadius.

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: The empty state's 56 key tile.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Windows and dialogs as designs draw them; macOS 26 rounder still.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Push buttons, segmented controls, the filter field, icon buttons (circles), dots. Code: theme.Capsule, the theme Radius.

shadow.note: Glass casts almost nothing: cards and bars in the flow are flat with a card-rim; only the window, menus and the chosen segment have a shadow, and the system draws the window's.

tokens.name: shadow-raised

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: System menus and dialogs as designs draw them.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: A window in a design: the rim, the system's outline and shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A card's rim (card-rim along its top edge, inside it). Code: theme.Card.

size.note: Fixed sizes in DIPs at the default text size; they scale with it. A component takes its height from here, never a number of its own.

tokens.name: icon-stroke

tokens.name: row

tokens.name: badge-l

tokens.name: dot

tokens.name: dot-s
tokens.usage: A connectivity dot in a list row.

tokens.name: dot-l

tokens.name: countdown

tokens.name: hairline

tokens.name: detail-label

tokens.name: accounts-list

motion.note: Idset holds still: state changes take effect at once. Time is used to say something, never to decorate.

tokens.name: motion-none
tokens.usage: Default: every state change, hover and press.

tokens.name: motion-ack
tokens.usage: Copied, written, undone and updated acknowledgements stay this long, then go at once (c.After).

tokens.name: motion-undo
tokens.usage: The undo window, from an absolute deadline; the countdown line shortens in fifths, once a second, with no animation.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Element transitions, only as an agreed exception in docs/design.md (MyGo default). Reduced motion jumps to the target.

opacity.note: Opacity values come only from here.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A control that cannot be used: buttons, icon buttons, switches.

tokens.name: opacity-countdown
tokens.usage: The undo countdown line's commit mint.

audit.note: The contrast audit. Text and meaning colors are checked on every ground a text can sit on: each stack is laid on solid (the reference ground), alpha over alpha. Change any color and run the audit again; a token whose value differs from the code is listed in pending until the screen that uses it moves over.
audit.targetsNote: accent, danger and success are text on solid and card (4.5:1); on a selected row the accent is a glyph (3:1), and dark danger on a card is held to 3.5 because it always comes with its glyph. warning is never text (3:1). faint is decoration and disabled only. Rows on a card (the bind list, an overlap card) take hover and pressed but never selected: what a card's row stands for is said by its words, so selected is only checked on a region.
